title: Progress, Not Purrfection
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Did you know this very website is still under construction?
I’m still hissing at the code, knocking things off the shelf, chasing bugs

And that’s okay — because life works the same way.

We’re all a bit unfinished. We learn, we change, we molt old fur and grow new.
You don’t have to get everything “right” today. Or tomorrow.

You’re not a final product — you’re a work in progress.
That’s the beauty of being alive.

So next time you feel messy, stuck, or behind, remember:
it doesn’t have to be perfect to be real!

Aim for tiny steps, gentle progress, soft curiosity.
Rest when you need to. Purr when you can.

We’re building this site together — one paw at a time.
And you’re building yourself, one day at a time.

Progress, not purrfection. Always.
